result:
I fixed the order-dependence in F-DG7-962, but one acceptance check is still open: the full integration project never finished. It was cut off by the 3600 s time limit I gave the background job, after 410 of 474 files had passed with none failing. It is not a pass.

**The fix.** `p7-transfer-guards.test.ts` now runs in its own scratch database. It creates and migrates the database at the start and drops it at the end, so the shared test database never sees its rows. Cleaning up afterwards wasn't possible: `migration_import`, the reconciliation deltas and `audit_event` are append-only even for the owner, and the file itself tests that. `transfer-export.test.ts` already works the same way. I added one test that checks both roles really are connected to the scratch database. The 21 existing guard tests are unchanged. No product code, migrations or API endpoints changed, and I found no product defect. Creating and migrating the extra database makes the file take about 13 s instead of 0.3 s.

**Order independence.** I ran the files in a fixed order, one at a time:

| Run | Exit | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Guard file first, then contract and response-validation | 0 | 252/252 passed |
| Contract and response-validation first, then guard file | 0 | 252/252 passed |
| Old guard file first (check that the test catches the bug) | 1 | 9 tests failed with 422 `migration.export_in_progress`, as in the finding |

**Other checks** (all exit 0):
- `pnpm -r typecheck`
- `pnpm lint`
- `pnpm openapi:lint` (965 operations)
- `pnpm test` (two tests skipped in `fuzz.test.ts`, which I didn't touch)
- the repository-wide prettier check, re-run after my last edit
- `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG6`

The guard file alone passes 22/22 on a disposable PostgreSQL.

**Full integration run.** Contract and response-validation both passed within the 410 files, but the guard file hadn't run yet. Vitest never printed a summary or exit code. I didn't restart it because I was already past the 75-minute budget and the run takes about 85–90 minutes. Still to do: one complete run of `tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh npx vitest run --project integration` with a limit of at least 7200 s, recording its exit code.

**Open question (product, outside this task).** Should `listMigrationImports` skip or flag an import with no reconciliation run, instead of failing the whole list with a 500? The QA reviewer noted this. The command-line tool always writes both together, so only a direct owner write to the database can cause it.

F-DG7-962 stays open until a reviewer who didn't write the fix verifies it.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG7/`:
- T-DG7-BE-R7-backend-workflow-engineer.md (the handback)
- T-DG7-BE-R7-evidence/ (logs 01–11 and a copy of the run-order config)
